Potentiometer is at position 0 (lower third). Only LED1 should be on, and RGB LED should display red at maximum brightness.'}

test2: {'time': 1.0, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'on', 'rgb1': {'red': 'off', 'green': 'off', 'blue': 'on'}}, 'description': 'Potentiometer moved to position 1 (upper third). Only LED3 should be on, and RGB LED should display blue at maximum brightness.'}

test3: {'time': 1.5, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': {'red': 'on', 'green': 'off', 'blue': 'off'}}, 'description': 'Potentiometer moved back to position 0 (lower third). Only LED1 should be on, and RGB LED should display red at maximum brightness.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
